rationale: The workflow runs pip install -r requirements.txt in every matrix cell across three jobs (15 pip installs per run) with no dependency cache, so repeated dependency fetching is measurable. The P-LIT-GHA-CACHE pattern and the measured Python experiment (experiment:batch-hiruni-pattern-bat-ae496965ffa682a2-r2, ~9.2% elapsed savings) support adding actions/cache@v4 for ~/.cache/pip before installation. The cache key uses hashFiles('requirements.txt') because that is the actual pinned dependency file installed by the workflow (pyproject.toml only declares the build system), so changes to requirements correctly invalidate the cache. All test steps, matrices, environments, and required checks are preserved; only a cache step is added before each install step, with no new privileges, secrets, network targets beyond the existing S3/wget step, or deployment/publishing actions.
